changes: Clarified the close-up subject as an adult while preserving the intimate woman-and-cat composition, knitted texture, expressive eyes, and dramatic monochrome light.

project_info.theme: intimate black-and-white portrait of an adult woman and black cat
project_info.color_palette: deep black, charcoal, white, and silver-gray highlights

main_subject.description: An adult woman with natural skin texture and loose dark hair, holding a black cat close beside her face with one expressive eye sharply visible.
main_subject.wardrobe: Dark knitted sweater with rich tactile fibers that blend into the cat's smooth black fur.
main_subject.pose: Close-up embrace with the woman's cheek near the cat's head; both the woman's eye and the cat's reflective eyes face the camera calmly.

composition_elements.framing: Tight vertical close-up combining the woman's partial face and the cat's full face, with both sets of eyes as focal points.
composition_elements.environment: Minimal near-black background with no text or logos.
composition_elements.focus: Sharp woman's eye, cat eyes, whiskers, fur strands, and sweater knit against soft shadow falloff.

lighting_and_atmosphere.lighting: Soft directional light across the visible eye and cat face with dramatic contrast, controlled catchlights, and deep shadows.
lighting_and_atmosphere.atmosphere: Intimate, emotional, artistic, quiet, and richly textured.

technical_specs.camera: Full-frame camera with an 85mm macro-capable portrait lens at f/2.8, 1/125 s, ISO 400
technical_specs.quality: High-detail photorealistic monochrome, natural skin texture, realistic fur, soft grain, and accurate eye reflections

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a high-detail 2:3 moody black-and-white close-up portrait of an adult woman with natural skin texture and loose dark hair holding a black cat close beside her face. One expressive eye of the woman is sharply visible, and the cat's bright reflective eyes, smooth fur, whiskers, and nose are also in clear focus. She wears a dark knitted sweater whose tactile fibers blend into the cat's fur. Use soft directional light across the visible eye and cat face, dramatic contrast, controlled catchlights, deep near-black shadows, a minimal background, subtle film grain, and no text or logos.
